about.title: About Me
about.content: I am an IT and data professional with experience spanning software quality assurance, data analytics, technical support, and business operations. My work focuses on translating requirements into reliable systems, transforming data into actionable insights, identifying quality issues, and supporting organizations through structured technology solutions. I am currently pursuing a Doctor of Computer Science, building on graduate training in Information Technology and a professional background across consulting, analytics, IT support, and organizational operations.

featured_work.title: Startup Capital Assessment (NSCR)
featured_work.summary: Product validation and quality assurance support for NSCR - an AI-powered platform that evaluates startup funding readiness across investor criteria, producing a Capital Readiness Score, AI analysis, and actionable recommendations for founders.
highlights: Validated end-to-end assessment flows from founder intake through score generation and recommendation delivery.
Tested scoring consistency across five investor-aligned readiness dimensions, including edge cases and output clarity.
Reviewed capital readiness scorecards, AI narrative evaluation, and founder-facing recommendation modules before release.
Logged and retested product defects related to scoring logic, result presentation, and assessment workflows.

roles.summary: Supported software quality assurance, testing, defect management, and cross-functional software delivery.
responsibilities: Designed and executed 150+ manual and automated test cases covering functional, regression, system, and user acceptance requirements.
Identified, documented, and tracked 60+ software defects and quality issues through resolution and retesting.
Supported testing and quality assurance activities across 15+ software releases and sprint cycles.
Collaborated with 5+ cross-functional team members including developers, project managers, and IT professionals.
Translated technical and business requirements into structured test scenarios and validation procedures.
Performed regression testing following software changes to verify fixes and reduce recurring defects.

Produced 25+ analytical reports, summaries, and data-driven recommendations.
Conducted exploratory and trend analysis across local, national, and global datasets.
Performed recurring data-quality assessments to identify inconsistencies, missing values, and anomalies.
Translated complex analytical findings into clear insights for organizational stakeholders.

items.title: Machine Learning and Automated Defect Prediction in Agile QA Pipelines
items.journal_or_conference: International Journal of Software Engineering & Quality Assurance (IJSEQA)
items.abstract: This paper investigates predictive machine learning models integrated within CI/CD pipelines to forecast regression defects before deployment. Using historical commit histories and code complexity metrics, the framework demonstrates an 18% improvement in early defect detection compared to conventional test scheduling algorithms.

items.title: Data Cleansing and Integrity Validation Frameworks for Heterogeneous Enterprise Datasets
items.journal_or_conference: Proceedings of the IEEE International Conference on Big Data and Information Systems
items.abstract: Enterprise analytics are heavily vulnerable to noise and inconsistent schemas in merged operational data. This paper proposes a robust heuristic framework combining rule-based schema validation with statistical anomaly detection, reducing data preparation overhead by 40% across tabular relational stores.

items.title: Benchmarking Test Automation Frameworks for Web and Mobile Cloud Environments
items.journal_or_conference: Doctor of Computer Science Working Paper Series, University of the Potomac
items.abstract: A comprehensive comparative study assessing performance, maintenance overhead, and reliability across modern test automation suites (Selenium, Playwright, Cypress) executing against distributed cloud test farms under varying network conditions.
